# Snapshot Reports

## Start Here

[Snapshot selection](../../../src/snapshot/actions.rs), [comparison conversion](../../../src/snapshot/capture_report.rs), [publication](../../../src/snapshot/site.rs), and [frontend guide](../../../frontend/README.md).

## Procedure and Invariants

1. Read existing comparison data from the active output directory, including environment/custom-output overrides. Preserve suite filters and explicit misses.
1. Resolve report text per field: explicit `--title`/`--heading`/`--subheading`, then workspace `snapshotTitle`/`snapshotHeading`/`snapshotSubheading`, then built-in defaults. Preserve explicit empty strings and CLI values equal to the defaults. Automatic `test`/`ref` reports must leave CLI text options unset.
1. Desktop Snapshot/Deploy must also leave unchosen report text unset in `RunOptions` and omit its CLI flags. Verify both the argument builder and bundled-worker staging; CLI-only tests do not cover desktop-generated overrides.
1. Preserve safe Markdown subheadings and plain-text title/heading escaping. Raw HTML and embedded Markdown images are excluded; external page links allow only uncredentialed HTTP(S).
1. Keep version-2 Rust report types and [frontend schemas](../../../frontend/src/data/report.ts) synchronized. Tracked suites use the latest completed full-suite `runs.json` record and compare missing reports on demand; legacy suites retain `config.js` selection. Verify `report.json` identity/inventory, never execute report JavaScript, and hold artifact read ownership while converting. See [run retention](../run-retention/SKILL.md).
1. Reserve capture `error` and summary `errors` for failures preventing reference/test capture. Pixel/dimension mismatches, missing references, and comparison failures remain failed comparisons; retain their diagnostics in optional `comparisonError`. Normalize the legacy overloaded `engineErrorMsg` and older frontend `error` fields. Image URLs can point to error placeholders, so their presence does not prove capture success.
1. Keep `mismatch` as the unrounded numeric audit value and carry optional integer `mismatchPixels` from the saved comparison. Never infer absent counts. Format only in views: keep two decimals when nonzero, increase through 12 decimals before scientific notation, and reserve `0.00%` for actual zero. Run `bun test src/data/report.test.ts --test-name-pattern mismatch` and `bun run test:e2e --grep 'tiny mismatch'` on development and generated reports.
1. Optional `logs.reference/test` metadata retains five archive states and original identities. Public chunks are capture-only, at most 250 records/256 KiB, and explicit versioned dependencies. Keep lazy text rendering and `view=log` deep links synchronized with [logging docs](../../../docs/commands.md#diagnostic-verbosity); never package raw journals.
1. Optional suite `displayName` is presentation-only in summaries and suite JSON. Use frontend `suiteLabel` and retain IDs in routes/paths. Captures record `suite.json` metadata; its explicit empty label clears a legacy report label. Desktop suite mutation stages the site updater before publishing refreshed URLs and pruning unreferenced generated assets.
1. Supply scenario names and generated capture labels through the [shared Rust resolver](../../../src/helpers/scenario_names.rs), not a second SPA algorithm. Prefer captured `scenarioDisplayName`; derive legacy names from original URLs across logical scenarios in the report. Keep explicit labels, capture IDs, filenames, source URLs, and routes independent of generated presentation names.
1. Every script, CSS, font, manifest, suite JSON, and image URL uses a stable filename plus `?v=` from `get_asset_version(bytes, 20)`. Frontend build uses matching SHA-384/base64url encoding; verify generated references against Rust, including font-to-CSS version propagation.
1. Stage and validate all selected suites before publishing stable paths. Replace files atomically, HTML last, then prune only stale generated `_snapshot` files. Validate decoded canonical path components, symlink boundaries, and query/content versions at publication/staging boundaries. Never join URLs including queries to filesystem paths.
1. Develop source in `frontend`; `bun run build` replaces `src/snapshot/data` and generates `assets.rs`. Do not hand-edit generated files. Keep capture-owned error artwork in `src/test/data`, outside this replaced directory.
1. Build in an isolated checkout without concurrent writers to `frontend/dist`, `frontend/hosting`, or `src/snapshot/data`. Asset sync rejects observed symlinks but path-based checks do not prevent concurrent replacement; see [the open issue](../../../OUTSTANDING_ISSUES.md#frontend-asset-build-race-2026-11-02).
1. Preserve generated bytes with the `-text` rule in [.gitattributes](../../../.gitattributes). When resource-version checks fail, inspect `git ls-files --eol -- src/snapshot/data`: CRLF conversion changes hashes even in a clean checkout. Rebuild existing converted assets; never normalize hash inputs or weaken the Rust check. The asset-sync tests require Git and verify LF/CRLF preservation with autocrlf enabled.
1. Keep frontend source text at LF with `frontend/** text=auto eol=lf`; binary assets must remain binary. Run the repository formatter on an already-converted checkout, not global Git configuration changes. The asset-sync regression checks source attributes and unchanged binary hashes with autocrlf enabled.
1. Routes use origin-root clean URLs with Azure/Netlify/Cloudflare fallback. HTML revalidates; versioned resource URLs cache immutably. CDN keys must include `v`. Exclude `/_snapshot/*` from SPA fallback; do not promise historical origin versions after deployment. Cloudflare translates `/suites/* /index.html 200` to `/suites/* / 200` in API metadata to avoid Workers canonical-HTML redirect loops.
1. Keep Netlify's global headers aligned with Azure's `globalHeaders`, including referrer and MIME-sniffing protection. Edit hosting sources, regenerate embedded assets, and check required cache directives independent of ordering or extra directives.
1. Keep deployment inventory and post-compression query versions synchronized without renaming files. Never package the entire output directory or include raw captures, state, or stale assets.
1. The CLI optimizer skips `_snapshot`; optimize source captures before generating a new snapshot. Never mutate published bytes without updating their URL hash.
1. Existing visual failures remain report data. Malformed input or generated-file write failures are process errors; do not broadly swallow optional-file errors.
1. Name the operation and affected path for discovery, staging, artifact I/O, and cleanup failures, retaining the original OS error and excluding file contents. Snapshot staging is inside the output root. Windows error 5 is access denied; sharing-lock regressions produce error 32, not proof of an ACL failure. Only removal of a confirmed-empty generated directory is best-effort: ignore already-removed paths, warn and continue on other removal errors. Directory reads, stale-file deletion, artifact I/O, and symlink checks remain fatal. Never change permissions automatically or delete recursively to bypass a failed empty-directory removal.
1. Review navigation shows the current suite label in a searchable Floating UI dropdown, with selected-suite scenarios visible below. Opening the bounded, independently scrolling overlay must not move scenarios. Preserve selected links, keyboard selection, outside/Escape dismissal, and search reset on close. Escape restores selector focus without scrolling; portal inside the native mobile dialog and keep Escape from also dismissing the drawer. Keep capture groups, search, loading/error states, and mobile content suite-scoped. The sidebar stays viewport-bounded below the measured sticky header and scrolls independently; suite, log, and error content uses document scrolling, with non-sticky breadcrumbs. Clamp divider width without losing the preferred desktop size on mobile.
1. Overview metrics are total tests, passed, failed, and aggregate pass rate; the table adds suite labels. All five columns sort ascending/descending with numeric counts and unrounded ratios, defaulting empty-suite rates to zero. Changing columns starts ascending in one URL update without dropping filters. At widths up to 760px, stack every suite's labeled metrics without horizontal scrolling; preserve sorting through a selector/direction button and accessible table headings. Engine errors use an inline number-only badge with a hover/focus/tap tooltip, singular/plural labels, and Escape/outside dismissal.
1. Highlight passed counts only for nonempty, fully passing results and failed counts whenever nonzero. Pass-rate fills are green for fully passing suites and neutral for failures, including engine errors. Use actual failed counts, not rounded percentages; preserve native progress values, accessible labels, and empty bars at 0%.
1. Keep the main/footer wrapper a growing flex column. Overview/suite footers belong at the dynamic viewport bottom on short pages and after long content in document flow, without overlap. Reserve and tint only the root page gutter, not the review wrapper; preserve the full-height body background before the app loads. Image review stays footer-free.
1. Image comparison keeps names/navigation/controls outside bounded image overflow. Only comparison mode constrains the app to the viewport; retain the review route's `main` flex minimum height. Side-by-side divides visible width into two or three fixed grid lanes. Every canvas uses maximum image width/height at a shared scale; images keep their dimensions and top-left origin. Native scrollbars expose oversized edges; underfilled canvases start centered and drag horizontally together until the widest image reaches a lane edge, without changing fit/zoom or adding overflow. Preserve normalized placement through resize and reset it with fits. Native wheel/trackpad/touch, scrollbar, drag, and key scrolling mirror both axes without scrolling the page. Record actual clamped peer offsets to suppress asynchronous feedback. Exclude zoom/layout-generated scroll events so per-pane pointer anchors remain intact. Retain pointer capture and release/cancel/lost-capture/blur/view cleanup. Ctrl/Cmd+wheel uses a non-passive listener on the stable review wrapper, including empty space and zoom limits; detach on leaving Comparison. Per-pane anchor padding uses full inner bounds so scrollbar changes cannot clamp the hovered pixel. Keep presets through 800%, no-upscale width/area fits, per-mode zoom, and scoped keys that yield to controls. Require width/height attributes on every image. Optional `imageSizes` records decoded PNG sizes, not comparison `dimensions` deltas; reserve the common canvas before load with legacy runtime discovery. Crosshairs do not require a diff and span each complete lane, including blank space beyond successful loaded images. Project coordinates through image bounds and saved alignment; retain missing-band and unavailable-image exclusions. Keep the overlay's positioned containing block outside the unpositioned native scroller so it cannot extend scroll ranges. Retain one-screen-pixel white strokes with dark outlines and refresh from the saved hover position on scroll, zoom, fit, and resize. Clear on lane exit, view changes, blur, touch, or drag. Capture Log and suite browsing retain document scrolling. Keep selectable Info stats and filtered failure arrows.
1. Reuse the desktop [icon source](../../../assets/icon.svg) for the logo and favicon. Bundle it once and content-version both URLs. Suite/image browser titles include the suite name and configured report title; overview navigation restores the report title.
1. Put report heading and safe Markdown subheading on separate lines in the compact shared header; the overview's page heading is `Snapshot Overview`, with localized generation date/time directly beneath it. Center overview content within 1080px and omit its breadcrumb row without changing review navigation. Keep empty values empty, wrap long text, and size review panes from the actual header height instead of a fixed pixel offset.
1. Suite list rows show equal-width Reference/Test lanes and a Diff lane only when present, including on phones. Contain complete previews without cropping, retain missing-image lanes, and preserve filters/view selection when opening captures. Grid view keeps one thumbnail.
1. Generate optional version-2 `previews` with `image::thumbnail` and explicit PNG Fast/Sub encoding: full-image lanes at most 640x480, full-width grid thumbnails at most 640x400 (diff-cropped around the first diff row with a top context margin when a diff exists, top-cropped from `test` otherwise, top-cropped from dimmed `reference` with a 25%-opacity contained error icon overlay when only `reference` was captured, or the contained error icon when neither was captured; short pages align to the top of `.capture-thumbnail`), no upscaling or copied metadata. Validate `.error.json` sidecars through `checked_file` and `read_bounded` before reading. Identical input must produce byte-identical previews. Decode once per source, omit unused grid encodes, and preserve original bytes/URLs for comparison and downloads. Include every preview in inventory, rename/delete, compression roles, and version refresh. Corrupt input must fail staging without changing the published site. The shared preview observer uses the document viewport (`root: null`), not the non-scrolling review wrapper, to bound active image sources. Keep labels, links, keyboard access, filtering and failure jumps intact, including older reports without previews.
1. Apply theme preferences synchronously in the document head before the app bundle. Keep the critical background palette aligned with the main stylesheet and lower in specificity. Storage is optional; persist only explicit selections, synchronize other tabs, and follow OS appearance only in System mode. Snapshot theme controls belong in Settings > Appearance; keep the controller mounted while the dialog is closed. Settings uses bounded, scrollable sections with visible dismissal and native modal focus behavior.
1. Publish `/_snapshot/status.json` with aggregate capture counts and timestamp only. This version-1 endpoint is unversioned, CORS-public, and revalidated, unlike immutable report JSON. Check it against the active manifest and include it in exact deployment inventories. Landing pages fetch it anonymously from linked origins; never infer local workspace ownership.
1. Same-origin manifest, suite, and log fetches use `credentials: "same-origin"`; `omit` strips cookie-gateway sessions such as Cloudflare Access, whose cross-origin sign-in redirect surfaces as CORS. Keep cross-origin landing status anonymous. Header assertions inspect finished requests because development StrictMode aborts a duplicate first fetch (`--grep 'access cookies'`).

## Checks

```sh
cargo test --lib snapshot::
cargo test --lib helpers::scenario_names::tests
cargo test --features desktop --lib snapshot::capture_report::tests
cargo test --lib config::tests::snapshot_report_text_loads_from_workspace_yaml
cargo test --features desktop --lib snapshot::site::tests
```

The `snapshot_io_errors_` filter covers unavailable output/staging and Windows file locks. `snapshot_cleanup_keeps_blocked_empty_directories_without_failing` verifies optional directory cleanup, unchanged deployment inventory/captures, and later retry. On Windows, `cargo test --features gui --test desktop_worker snapshot_worker_` covers fatal artifact errors versus warning-only empty-directory removal, stderr paths, and retry without credentials or network access.

In `frontend`, run `bun run lint`, `bun run test`, `bun run build`, and `bun run test:e2e`. Browser tests require an existing Chromium executable or an explicit Playwright install. Use synthetic fixtures; never production credentials. Generate with `cargo run --bin regressify -- --root frontend/.fixtures/workspace snapshot`, then `bun run preview` and `SNAPSHOT_URL` for production-bundle browser checks. Cover empty data, filters, hostile labels/URLs, repeated generation, write errors, deep-link refresh, mobile navigation, and all image modes. Keep `.fixtures` out of Biome. Verify lane alignment, mouse-controlled wipe, native page scrolling without scale changes, independent panes, divider mouse/keyboard bounds and persistence, suite-scoped scenarios, failure-arrow endpoints, and Info hover/pinning/selection/clipboard/Escape behavior. Check logo/favicon bytes against the shared SVG, title updates across navigation/refresh, and list lanes with absent diffs, missing images, and long labels.

For footer/layout changes, run `bun run test:e2e --grep 'footer|page scrollbar|review panes|large suites'` against development and generated reports. Verify root scrolling, sticky header, independently scrolling sidebar, single page gutter, and bounded previews on desktop/mobile. Native-scrollbar pixel tests cover long pages and empty gutter colors in both themes; keep image-canvas scrolling separate.

For failure classification, run the converter tests and `bun run test:e2e --grep 'visual mismatches remain failed'` against development and generated reports. Check zero-pixel dimension mismatches, missing references, comparison errors, genuine capture failures with placeholders, legacy payloads, filter counts, and Info labels.

For navigation and overview changes, run `bun run test:e2e --grep 'review navigation|review panes|overview|pass-rate bars distinguish'` against development and generated reports. Open the suite selector before suite selection/search; menu overflow is separate from scenario-pane overflow. Use viewport-only screenshots while the dropdown is open: full-page Chromium captures can briefly resize to 1x1 and unmount responsive navigation. Dropdown checks cover visible current labels, no layout shift, keyboard selection, empty search results, dismissal/focus, mobile dialog isolation, long labels, viewport bounds, and accessibility. Overview tests cover all sort columns/directions, filter persistence, aggregate totals, count highlights, inline error tooltips, the dated heading, and retained review breadcrumbs. Check stacked metrics at 320/390/600/760px and table reflow at 761px. Pass-rate tests check rendered pixels in both themes, including empty suites and failures that round to 100%, on desktop and in stacked mobile rows.

For crosshair changes, run `bun run test:e2e --grep 'side by side crosshairs|scrolling over images'` against development and generated reports. Carry optional comparer `alignment` through version-2 data; never guess a vertical gap from colors or dimensions. Validate source/diff heights, map through aligned diff rows, and hide a target guide inside its missing band. Cover inserted/deleted bands from every source lane, exact row boundaries, legacy metadata absence, equal/unequal dimensions, fit/manual zoom and stroke widths, missing/broken images, lane gaps, view changes, touch/cancel/blur cleanup, and native scrolling. Hover empty lane space and small-image padding; verify viewport-spanning guides through stationary-pointer scroll, zoom, and fit reset. Check image and guide geometry inside the lane, not the image wrapper. Image nodes ignore pointer events; hover their wrappers before measuring settled bounds.

For viewer interactions, also run `bun test src/components/ComparisonViewer.test.ts` and `bun run test:e2e --grep 'image viewer |image modes, zoom|comparison images are centered'`. Verify fixed two/three-lane widths and heights, exact shared maximum canvas dimensions for unequal images, linked native scrollbars without feedback, reachable image edges, stationary names/controls, pointer anchoring across fit/scrollbar boundaries, empty-space wheel cancellation, both fits, per-mode zoom, limits, scoped keys, and double-click. Underfilled width/height each retain normalized placement: test horizontal, vertical, and diagonal dragging from every lane to all edges, unchanged zoom, no added overflow, resize, oversized-axis scrolling, fit reset to horizontal centering/top alignment, and anchoring after dragging. Use integer pointer coordinates and derive expected image pixels from them. Keep bounded drag endpoints inside the lane to avoid hovering toolbar popovers. Measure native clamped limits rather than assuming scrollbar-gutter arithmetic. Scroll crosshair targets into their source lane; Playwright hover offsets exclude pane borders. Disable entrance motion for geometry checks. Toolbar zoom leaves native offsets alone; only pointer gestures anchor.

For image sizing, run `bun run test:e2e --grep 'reserve dimensions|legacy suite|suite previews'` against development and generated reports, plus converter and schema tests. Pause image responses to verify attributes, canvas geometry, and fit zoom before/after loading in every comparison mode and after failures. Disable entrance motion with reduced-motion emulation; preserve legacy reports without size metadata and unloaded-image crosshair exclusion.

For header/settings/theme changes, run `bun run test:e2e --grep 'report header|settings popup|theme|very long report text'` against development and generated reports. Open Settings before choosing a theme. Block the app bundle to verify initial appearance; check saved/system precedence, unavailable storage, cross-tab resets while closed, and no automatic preference writes. Verify compact spacing, safe/empty/long text, keyboard navigation, dismissal/focus return, and scrolling future settings in short viewports. Native Tab may visit browser chrome but must not focus the inert background.

For preview changes, run `cargo test --lib snapshot::capture_report::tests` and the desktop snapshot/deployment gates. Run `bun run test:e2e --grep 'large suites|suite previews|legacy suite|suite list|suite failure|review panes'` on development and generated reports. Check complete encoded-byte repeatability, dimensions/crops/alpha, corrupt-input preservation, exact ZIP inventory, version refresh, bounded active sources, no original-image requests while browsing, and original comparison/download URLs. Wait for a view transition to commit before filtering; mobile comparison defaults to a single lane. Treat frame timings as diagnostics, not portable timing assertions.

## Maintain

Update [command docs](../../../docs/commands.md), [frontend guide](../../../frontend/README.md), deployment consumers, and this skill. Frontend pushes to `release` use the [asset workflow](../../workflows/snapshot-assets.yml) to open a generated-only PR to `master`.
